environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API) with Lambda proxy integration. CORS is configured with AllowOrigin: '*' and AllowCredentials: true. The API Gateway has no custom authorizer beyond the Lambda's internal session check. The Lambda execution role has full DynamoDB access (dynamodb:* on arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/UserProfiles, arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/Resources, arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/UserSessions). No WAF is attached to the API Gateway stage. Cookie SameSite attribute is set to 'None' with Secure flag for cross-origin mobile app compatibility.
